decisions.reason: As a niche particle-therapy device with a constrained launch and weaker website prominence than the chamber products, it is more likely to have fallen short of aspiration levels and to have its resources redirected to stronger core dosimetry lines.

This small-volume ionization chamber fits the firm's core measurement and calibration capabilities, and its continued stand-alone presentation suggests performance close enough to aspirations to justify retention.
As another core dosimetry chamber supported across two years, it likely remains within the firm's acceptable performance range and benefits from organisational slack and product-family synergies.
A standard clinical ionization chamber line with several models is closely tied to the firm's established business, making it likely to meet aspirations and be kept.
Relative-dosimetry chambers are complementary to the firm's QA portfolio, and without evidence of clear failure management would likely continue the product rather than trigger problemistic search.
The thimble ionization chamber is a conventional product in the firm's technical domain, so its strategic fit and supportability make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
